ic_method: per-date Spearman vs y_excess_20d on label notna & y_clean rows, >=100 names/date, averaged within calendar month; t = mean/(std/sqrt(n_months)); residual IC = Spearman(y, residual of the feature's per-date rank after OLS on [1, champion per-date centered ranks (NaN->0), NaN indicators]); 'quad' adds squared ranks; BH across the 23 new features (rank-equivalent pairs included, conservative)

clusters.method: KMeans(k=12, n_init=20, seed 108) on per-ticker standardized market-residual daily returns (OLS on the universe-median return over the window; |ret|>22% split/circuit days dropped); tickers = in the PIT universe on >=1 window session with >=100 valid returns

definitions.ats_chg_20: per-date z of [5d-mean log(turnover/trades) minus its value 20 sessions earlier]
definitions.trades_z_20: (trades - 20d mean)/20d std, window incl. today (vol_z_20 convention)
definitions.deliv_value_share_20: 20d sum(deliv_qty*close) / 20d sum(turnover) on rows with delivery data (min 15)
definitions.gap_fill_10: 10-session mean (min 3 gap days) of (open-close)/(open-prev_close) on days with |gap|>=0.25%, clipped to +-3; prev_close = bhavcopy PREV_CLOSE (CA-adjusted)
definitions.range_position_20: (close - 20d min low)/(20d max high - 20d min low), min 15 rows
definitions.amihud_20: per-date z of log(20d mean |ret_1d| / turnover in Rs crore), |ret|>22% days excluded
definitions.resid_mom_63: 63-session sum (min 45) of e_t = r_t - a_t - b_t m_t, (a_t,b_t) = 60-session OLS (min 40) ending at t; m = universe-median ret_1d; |r|>22% excluded
definitions.idio_vol_60: residual std of that regression (n-2 dof)
definitions.cs_rank_*: per-date percentile rank over the universe
definitions.cr_<x>: x minus its cluster's per-date universe median (>=5 names)
definitions.cluster_mom_20 / cluster_ret_126: cluster's per-date median mom_20 / ret_126d (>=5 names)

external_data_gaps.data: Index and F&O membership (Nifty 50/100/500, F&O list, MWPL ban list)
external_data_gaps.adds: inclusion/exclusion demand shocks; F&O eligibility = short-sale feasibility
external_data_gaps.mechanism: index-demand price pressure (Shleifer 1986; Harris & Gurel 1986); overpricing persists where shorting is hard (Miller 1977): non-F&O NSE names cannot be shorted overnight except through SLB
external_data_gaps.source: NSE archives fo_mktlots.csv and the F&O UDiFF bhavcopy (membership), fo_secban.csv (ban list); niftyindices.com constituent CSVs plus NSE Indices rebalancing press releases (history)

external_data_gaps.adds: true industry momentum, sector-neutral ranking, lead-lag across linked industries
external_data_gaps.mechanism: industry momentum (Moskowitz & Grinblatt 1999); slow diffusion across linked firms (Hou 2007; Cohen & Frazzini 2008). The return-correlation clusters here are only a statistical stand-in
external_data_gaps.source: NSE 4-level industry classification (macro sector / sector / industry / basic industry) in the NSE equity master and the niftyindices.com constituent files; AMFI half-yearly market-cap categorisation

external_data_gaps.mechanism: value and profitability premia (Fama & French 2015; Novy-Marx 2013), accrual anomaly (Sloan 1996), post-earnings-announcement drift (Bernard & Thomas 1989)
external_data_gaps.source: Reg-33 LODR XBRL results filed on NSE/BSE (free, needs parsing); vendors CMIE Prowess, ACE Equity, Capitaline, LSEG, Bloomberg

external_data_gaps.adds: event timing (results, buybacks, pledges, insider trades) and price adjustment factors
external_data_gaps.mechanism: event drift and PEAD (Bernard & Thomas 1989), buyback drift (Ikenberry, Lakonishok & Vermaelen 1995), insider-trade signals (Seyhun 1986). CA factors would also replace the unadjusted-price y_clean mask, which drops 7.5% of labelled rows
external_data_gaps.source: NSE corporate filings (announcements, corporate actions, board meetings), BSE announcements API, SEBI PIT/SAST disclosures carried by both exchanges

external_data_gaps.adds: IV skew, call-put IV spread, implied-minus-realised vol, futures OI/basis (the README's out-of-scope 'carry')
external_data_gaps.mechanism: IV skew predicts returns (Xing, Zhang & Zhao 2010); call-put IV spread (Cremers & Weinbaum 2010); volatility risk premium (Bali & Hovakimian 2009); India VIX as the regime conditioner the March-2026 break called for
external_data_gaps.source: NSE F&O bhavcopy (daily option settlement prices, OI, volume per strike: IV via Black-76), India VIX history (NSE), NSE participant-wise OI

external_data_gaps.adds: flow-induced price pressure; per-stock ownership change
external_data_gaps.mechanism: foreign flows predict EM returns (Froot, O'Connell & Seasholes 2001); flow-driven fire sales/purchases (Coval & Stafford 2007)
external_data_gaps.source: NSE/BSE daily FII/DII cash-market figures (aggregate only), NSDL FPI Monitor (aggregate, fortnightly by sector); per stock: quarterly shareholding patterns (NSE/BSE), daily bulk/block deal files (NSE archives), AMC monthly portfolio disclosures

external_data_gaps.adds: news tone, attention shocks, news-vs-no-news momentum
external_data_gaps.mechanism: media pessimism predicts reversals (Tetlock 2007); drift after news vs reversal without news (Chan 2003); attention-driven buying (Barber & Odean 2008)
external_data_gaps.source: licensed feeds (LSEG MarketPsych, Bloomberg, Dow Jones/Factiva); exchange announcements as structured events; GDELT (free, coarse)

external_data_gaps.data: India-specific: surveillance, price bands, SLB, promoter pledges
external_data_gaps.adds: ASM/GSM stage changes and price-band moves (mechanical liquidity limits); SLB borrow as short interest; pledge overhang
external_data_gaps.mechanism: trading restrictions shift liquidity and returns; short interest predicts returns (Desai et al. 2002; Boehmer, Jones & Zhang 2008); forced-sale risk from pledged promoter holdings
external_data_gaps.source: NSE daily ASM/GSM lists and sec_list.csv price bands; NSE SLB bhavcopy; SEBI SAST pledge disclosures (NSE 'pledged data')

strongest_cases_md:
- `deliv_value_share_20`: residual IC +0.0175, t +3.64, q 0.055, sign held in 75% of 16 months; after the quadratic control +0.0094; CV months +0.0165. A/B: not in any variant. **Does not clear the bar.**
- `amihud_20`: residual IC -0.0395, t -3.07, q 0.089, sign held in 75% of 16 months; after the quadratic control -0.0339; CV months -0.0121. A/B: not in any variant. **Does not clear the bar.**
- `idio_vol_60`: residual IC -0.0171, t -2.13, q 0.235, sign held in 56% of 16 months; after the quadratic control -0.0175; CV months -0.0056. A/B: not in any variant. **Does not clear the bar.**
limits_md:
- **Can decide:** whether a feature carries a large, steady signal the champion lacks. With 16 monthly ICs and a median monthly residual-IC std of 0.036, the smallest residual IC detectable at 5% is about 0.019. Anything weaker is indistinguishable from zero here. The test also catches gross failures: no variant may sit below 0.50 in any fold.
- **Cannot decide:** gains of about +0.005 AUC. Four CV folds give a standard error on mean CV AUC of about nan, so the pass mark sits within about one standard error of the control. A pass would still need confirmation and a fail does not prove the gain is zero. The sample also cannot decide anything that needs a cycle. It holds one regime break (March 2026) and only 7 observable months of `mom_12_1`. Signals that pay only in some regimes, such as cluster rotation, are out of reach, as is seasonality, because the archive calendar is simulated.
- **Adjacent ICs overlap.** Labels span 20 sessions, so adjacent daily ICs share most of their window and monthly t-stats run slightly optimistic. Monthly means are used for that reason. The 5-year walk-forward (~60 monthly folds) is where a +0.005 effect becomes decidable. Re-run this module on that dataset before closing the question.
